title: 第13章：镇外搜刮，提升实力
slug: 丧尸爆发我的房车能无限升级
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

转眼已是第二天早上。

林昊在镇长办公室里，见到了赵永年。

“赵镇长，总待在镇里也不是办法。坐吃山空。”林昊开门见山，“我打算带队出去，搜集物资，算作我们团队的工分。这样对大家都好。”

赵永年正用一块绸布擦着一个紫砂壶，听他这么一说，手上的动作停了下来。

他抬起头，脸上是那种标准的、职业假笑！

“好啊。年轻人有干劲，是好事。”

他放下茶壶，“不过外面危险，镇里也该派人协助。老马手下有几个机灵的，让他们跟你去，互相有个照应。”

“可以。”林昊点了一下头，

“不过搜刮到的东西，我们得留三成。车要油，人要吃饭，设备要维护。”

“这当然可以。”赵永年笑得更和善了，“就这么定了。”

第二天，合金房车驶出青山镇的大门。

车上除了林昊和赵铁柱，多了两个民兵。

瘦高个叫刘三，矮胖的叫王四。

两人上了车，眼睛就不够用了，东摸摸西看看，嘴里啧啧称奇。

“这车……比镇长的都漂亮。”刘三小声跟王四说着悄悄话。

目标是十公里外的一个废弃加油站。

系统地图上，那里只有几个零散的红点，价值不高，正好可以用来演戏。

车一停稳，加油站便利店里就晃出来七八只丧尸，后面陆陆续续又跟上几只。

“下车，准备战斗。”林昊喊了一声。

刘三和王四对视一眼，各自提着一根削尖的木棍，手心里全是汗。

赵铁柱第一个跳下车，防暴叉没用，提着那根绑了水果刀的窗帘杆矛。

他像一头猎豹，直接冲进尸群。

捅刺，横扫，上挑。每一个动作都干净利落，没有一丝多余。

一只丧尸扑过来，他侧身让过，矛杆顺势一绞，卡住丧尸脖子，往前一送，钉在加油站的柱子上。

林昊端着猎弩，站在车门旁边。

就像一个冷酷的杀手，正射杀那些从赵铁柱攻击范围外溜过来的丧尸。

一支，两支，每一箭都精准地钉进丧尸的头颅。

刘三和王四彻底看傻了。

他们也算是民兵，也杀过落单的丧尸，但那是十几个人围着一只打。

眼前这两个人，杀丧尸跟切菜一样。

一只丧尸绕过赵铁柱，嘶吼着冲向他们。

“啊！”王四吓得腿一软，手里的木棍都掉了。

刘三还算有点胆色，闭着眼把木棍捅出去，结果捅在了丧尸的肚子上，一点用没有。

就在那只丧尸张嘴要咬下去的瞬间，一支弩箭从它后脑勺穿了出来。

刘三和王四一屁股坐在地上，大口喘气，裤裆都湿了一片。

战斗结束。

赵铁柱的矛尖上滴着灰黑色的液体，他脚下躺着九具尸体。

林昊也射杀了四只。

In the blink of an eye it was the next morning.

Lin Hao met Zhao Yongnian in the mayor's office.

"Mayor Zhao, staying in the town all the time is not an option. Just sit back and have nothing." Lin Hao got straight to the point, "I plan to lead a team out to collect supplies, which will be counted as work points for our team. This is good for everyone."

Zhao Yongnian was wiping a purple clay pot with a piece of silk cloth. When he heard what he said, his hand movements stopped.

He raised his head with that standard, professional smirk on his face!

"Okay. It's a good thing that young people are motivated."

He put down the teapot, "But it's dangerous outside, and the town should send people to help. Lao Ma has a few smart people, let them go with you, and look out for each other."

"Okay." Lin Hao nodded,

"But we have to keep 30% of what we find. Cars need fuel, people need food, and equipment needs maintenance."

"Of course." Zhao Yongnian smiled more kindly, "That's it."

The next day, the alloy RV drove out of the gate of Qingshan Town.

In addition to Lin Hao and Zhao Tiezhu, there were two more militiamen in the car.

The tall and thin one is called Liu San, and the short and fat one is called Wang Si.

When the two got in the car, their eyes were exhausted. They looked around and marveled.

"This car... is more beautiful than the mayor's." Liu San whispered to Wang Si in a low voice.

The target was an abandoned gas station ten kilometers away.

On the system map, there are only a few scattered red dots there, which are not of high value and can be used for acting.

As soon as the car stopped, seven or eight zombies emerged from the gas station convenience store, followed by several more.

"Get out of the car and prepare to fight." Lin Hao shouted.

Liu San and Wang Si looked at each other, each holding a sharpened stick, their palms full of sweat.

Zhao Tiezhu was the first to jump out of the car. The anti-riot fork was useless, and he was holding the curtain pole spear with a fruit knife tied to it.

Like a cheetah, he rushed directly into the group of corpses.

Stab, sweep, and lift.Every movement is clean and neat, without a trace of excess.

A zombie rushed towards him, and he stepped aside. He twisted the spear pole, caught the zombie's neck, and sent it forward, nailing it to the pillar of the gas station.

Lin Hao was standing next to the car door holding a hunting crossbow.

Like a cold killer, he was shooting the zombies that slipped out of Zhao Tiezhu's attack range.

One, two, each arrow accurately penetrated the zombie's head.

Liu San and Wang Si were completely dumbfounded.

They were also considered militiamen, and they had killed lone zombies, but that was only when a dozen people surrounded one zombie.

The two people in front of me were killing zombies like chopping vegetables.

A zombie walked around Zhao Tiezhu and rushed toward them with a roar.

"Ah!" Wang Si was so frightened that his legs weakened and he dropped the wooden stick in his hand.

Liu San was still a little brave. He closed his eyes and thrust the wooden stick out, but it ended up stabbing the zombie in the stomach, which was of no use at all.

Just when the zombie opened its mouth to bite it, a crossbow arrow pierced the back of its head.

Liu San and Wang Si sat down on the ground, gasping for air, and their crotches were all wet.

The battle is over.

Gray-black liquid dripped from the tip of Zhao Tiezhu's spear, and nine corpses lay at his feet.

Lin Hao also shot four.
